brief: Goldman's 30 Oct mid-day color: US equities sell off (RTY>SPX>NDX) after disappointing overnight tech earnings, even as the SPX-ex-AI basket holds +35bps and breadth stays balanced (~55% of S&P lower). INTC falls 30% (worst intraday move on record), AMZN pares a -12% drop to -2.3%, SNDK -12.9%; AI-linked baskets (Momentum -4.5%, Hyperscalers -2.1%, Neoclouds -10.2%, Broad AI -5.8%) all decline, though GS's TMT desk sees demand in INTC and AMZN after heavy morning supply. Reports of tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz push WTI +2.5%. A Binance hack of $6.3bn drags the Bitcoin Sensitive basket -8.7%. AI angst drives a flight to safety: Cyclicals vs Defensives -2.6% on defensive strength, Bond Proxies +1.5%, and staples (XLP +1.6%, led by MDLZ/CL/CHD earnings beats) benefit from the rotation out of tech. Month-end dynamics loom: elevated closing auctions expected, the tax-loss-selling basket is -6.9%, pensions are modeled to buy $4.5bn (31st percentile), framed as a continuation of yesterday's $9bn buy MOC. GS's desk has fully unwound the week's net TMT buying and sold $2.5bn of tech today; LOs are 20% better for sale, HFs 7% better for sale with macro-product demand.
